title: A Vow for the Letters
author: Hazel Coldharbour
blurb: Odile Fairweather, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
